notes.title: These 9 PS Plus games are leaving the game catalogue forever in March
notes.content:
Nine games are leaving PS Plus this month, never to return to the service again! As such, if you've got a PS Plus Extra subscription, you should redeem these games as soon as possible, before they're taken away.

A combination of both PS4 and PS5 games, these titles are downloadable and playable on both of these consoles only. If you own either of these, then you're good to go.

notes.title: Join the PC Gamer Club and get a copy of Velocibox
notes.content:
Every month, PC Gamer Club Legendary members get a code sent to their inbox. How do you become a Legendary member? We'll get to that further down the page, but first let's talk about Velocibox—this month's game which starts going out to new and existing Legendary members today. 

Velocibox is an endless runner with a twist. Like, a literal twist, as you're required to flip and turn its ever-moving levels so as to overcome obstacles and collect power-ups. Throw some neat bullet-time-style mechanics and some break-neck speed rushes into that mix, and it looks a little something like this:

So, how do you become a Legendary member of the PC Gamer Club? It's simple, just head in this direction, select the appropriate heading, follow the instructions, and you're good to go. Here's everything you get as part of joining the PC Gamer Club. 

If you're on the fence, you might like to peruse this handy PC Gamer Club FAQ.

notes.title: Velocibox Win & OSX Upcoming Release + Linux Future
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Velocibox will soon be available on Steam! Thank you to everyone who've supported the project during its Greenlight phase. Being on Steam presents heaps of benefits for you as players. Some features implemented in the Steam build are as follows:

[list]
[*]Global Leaderboard
[*]Friends Leaderboard
[*]Stats & Achievements
[*]Trading Cards
[/list]

Velocibox will be available on September 8th 2014 for the Windows and OSX platform. A Linux version will be available in the near future once extensive testing can be done to ensure that the build is stable. Apologies for the delay.
